# Unsolved Problems Mega-Atlas (v2.4.0)

> Exhaustive, cryptographically audited cross-disciplinary open-problem research infrastructure: 1,900 strictly deduplicated unsolved, open, and hard problems spanning 8 Macro-Pillars, 28 Superdomains, 8 Physical/Formal Substrates, and 7 Abstraction Layers wired into 1 biconnected 5,808-edge knowledge graph (0 articulation points, 0 bridges, 0 dangling links), paired with 92 Pure Lean 4.35.0 formal invariant theorems across 6 independent kernels, a 10-page AMS-LaTeX white paper, offline SQLite FTS5 Hybrid RAG (100.0% MRR@5), a 10-tool stdio MCP server, and an immutable Karpathy-style AutoResearch harness (AQS = 97.99).

- **Author:** Alexander Stephen Donahue (`Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA`, ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`, `0_0@0thernes.art`)
- **Dual License:** Data/Figures/White Paper `CC-BY-4.0` · Code/Lean/RAG/MCP `Apache-2.0`
- **Honest Boundary:** Zero (`0/1,900`) overarching Atlas problems are retired; Lean verifies internal invariants only; rubric scores are falsifiable editorial estimates.

- [CLAIMS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/main/CLAIMS.md): Falsifiable Claims Ledger (`C1`–`C10`) with exact commands and refutation criteria

- [LIMITATIONS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/main/LIMITATIONS.md): Known limitations, platform caveats, and Literal vs. Metaphor table
- [Statement Fidelity Audit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/main/docs/statement-fidelity.md): 18-row Lean-vs-Python fidelity correspondence matrix
